readme: Runflow's plans (D-043): seats per role and prices in centavos. The single source for the mock, the backend (synced copy in backend/assets) and the apps (GET /v1/public/plans). Every club has exactly one owner. Free and Pro have hard limits; Max includes the seats below and charges each seat above them (extra). A paid plan whose payment fails stays usable for grace_days, then the club is frozen for its staff.
